acceptanceCriteria: impact and query emit the TCP-V0-140 notice in a no-snapshot checkout, covered by a test.
body: Observed in index lane PR beamfall/corvint#1427. With no snapshot, corvint context prints the stderr notice suggesting corvint index (TCP-V0-140); corvint impact and corvint query build in memory silently. Expected: all three read commands show the notice. Actual: context only.

completion.reason: Delivered on main ef2a01db52d5436c262725d136060c9eb95e8580 via batch beamfall/corvint#1464 (lane #1450); CI green on that commit (runs 39675360530,39677108995). Owner 2026-10-21: CI-checked work needs no local full-gate. Evidence file sha256 71f40a28aeb3669f621e118f63f433c3cee316fed20be810b94db7e13beeea0b.

title: Missing-snapshot in-memory build notice (TCP-V0-140) appears only in context, not impact or query
